title: Exercise production history reader busy-zero wiring and wrapped BUSY retries
outcome: Behavioral coverage protects the production history snapshot opener's nonblocking SQLite policy and retry recognition when BUSY is wrapped in context, so regression to a blocking pin under StateInner is detected.
acceptance: A behavioral test exercises the opener actually used by production history capture and verifies that SQLite contention cannot wait on the pin while StateInner is held.
A deterministic test exercises a context-wrapped DatabaseBusy opening failure and proves bounded retry, warning ownership and eventual success or existing deadline failure without real waits.
